newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar rises vs yen in Tokyo on Sakakibara report.
newsitem.headline: Dollar rises vs yen in Tokyo on Sakakibara report.

text.p: 0025 GMT --*Dollar edges higher against yen in early Tokyo on talk of news wire report that MOF's Sakakibara denied rumours that his ministry warned traders not to buy dollars above 119 yen, one dealer said.
*They said report also said Sakakibara denied that Japan warned of decisive action over 120 yen per dollar.
*Dollar well-supported on steady buying interest on dips below 118 yen.
*Short-covering pushed mark up vs yen. Mark was at 63.64/67 yen at 0023 GMT against 63.41 yen at Monday's New York close.
*At 0047 GMT, yield of 182nd 10-year Japanese government bond stood at 2.095 percent, compared with 2.115 percent at previous close.
*Profit-taking may cap dollar gains against mark following strong rally overnight, dealers said.
*Greenback rose as high as 1.8730 marks in Europe on Monday, highest since October 1989.
*Profit-taking and rumours that Germany would soon allow official interest rates to rise pushed dollar from lofty heights, despite broad dollar bullishness in New York trade.
*"U.S. operators were selling dollars for marks overnight and I believe further sales on book-squaring may emerge in Tokyo as well," a trust bank dealer said.
*Dealers said, however, that underlying sentiment towards mark remains weak.
